name: Work inbox
description: The Workbench's inbox: your agents' tasks in their own worktrees, sorted by what needs you. Pin, snooze or hide a task; start a new one. Picking one shows its Thread and its review.

reasons.agents:read: to list your agents and show the one you pick in the Thread beside the inbox
reasons.thread:read: to see which tasks have cards waiting for you
reasons.activity:read: to see which tasks are working right now
reasons.store:read: to remember pins, snoozes, hidden tasks and the task you picked
reasons.store:write: to save pins, snoozes, hidden tasks and the task you picked
reasons.git:read: to see each task's branch and how far it is from main
reasons.agents:start: to start a new task in its own worktree (K2 asks you first)
reasons.agents:stop: to stop a task's current turn when you press Stop
